ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_delta_regret_normalized_tanh_logsigmoid
ir.intuition: This loss uses the regret difference (delta_regret) to normalize the log probability gap, then applies a tanh nonlinearity to compress extreme normalized values before applying a logsigmoid link. This paradigm shift uses a normalized nonlinear contrastive approach on regrets rather than advantages or costs, emphasizing smooth gradients and bounded transformations to stabilize training while focusing on relative regret.
ir.pseudocode:
norm_gap = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(delta_regret) + eps)
squashed_gap = tanh(norm_gap)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(squashed_gap)
loss = mean(weight * loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    eps = 1e-6
    norm_gap = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.add(ops.abs(delta), eps))
    squashed = ops.tanh(norm_gap)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(squashed))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
